record.question: What does 'repetition time (TR)' refer to in MRI?
options: The time between successive radiofrequency pulses
The time it takes to produce an image
record.explanation: Answer A: The time between successive radiofrequency pulses. TR is the interval between successive excitation pulses for a given slice/sequence. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
